comment: The Supplier Registry overlaps potentially with the Product Registry, Facility Registry, organisation registry, procurement systems, and national business registries. The authoritative source for supplier identity and regulatory status is not clear.

public.text: The Supplier Registry overlaps potentially with the Product Registry, Facility Registry, organisation registry, procurement systems, and national business registries. The authoritative source for supplier identity and regulatory status is not clear.
public.suggestedRevision: Define the authoritative responsibility for legal identity, health-sector qualification, product authorisation, facility status, sanctions, and procurement eligibility. Use cross-references rather than duplicating the same entity data.
